verdict.rationale: Render's docs show a consistent set of primitives (render.yaml blueprint, CLI, REST API, autoscaling, managed DBs) that apply uniformly from prototype to scale, including autoscaling for 100x traffic bursts and managed migration paths, with community praise for its simple, consistent infra-as-code model versus Heroku/Terraform. missing for 10: no independent case study of a team scaling from prototype to massive production traffic without platform changes, and no detail on limits/edge cases at extreme scale.
